content.title: SaverOne 2014 signs preliminary agreement with ADAS technology provider
content.summary: SaverOne 2014 (SVRE) announced the signing of a preliminary agreement with a European-based automotive-technology provider, dedicated to providing sensor solutions. The collaboration will integrate SaverOne’s Vulnerable Road User detection solution with its Advanced Driver Assistance Systems sensor fusion platform, introducing a non-line-of-sight VRU detection capability to their ADAS sensor fusion platform. content.title: SaverOne Expands IP Portfolio With New US Patent, Stock Gains
content.summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. (NASDAQ:SVRE), a transportation safety technology company, has been awarded its 13th patent by the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). Issued on February 18, 2025, under patent number 12,231,899, the patent covers SaverOne’s system designed to restrict mobile phone use while driving.
